title: Neither Friend
notebook: The Arcturian Commonwealth and the Orythian Dominion both declined our trade protocol renewal.
Vyktor: we are not being punished. We are being ignored. That is sometimes worse.
The question: choose a side, or show Veltria does not need to choose.
dialogue: Both the Arcturian Commonwealth and the Orythian Dominion have declined Veltria's routine trade protocol renewal. In the same week. Without explanation.
monologue: The same week. That is not a coincidence. That is coordination — or the appearance of coordination, which is functionally the same thing.

narrative.text: Practical consequences are limited for now — these are protocol renewals, not active trade agreements. The signal is the problem. Both powers are telling us that a government which refuses to align is a government they will not prioritize. We are not being punished. We are being ignored. That is sometimes worse.
The question is whether we respond by choosing a side or by demonstrating that Veltria does not need to choose.

vyktor_coldness_brief.monologue: Being ignored is sometimes worse than being punished. Vyktor is right. A punished country is still a country worth punishing. An ignored country is just small.

choices.text: Reach out to Ambassador Cole. Warm the western relationship.
Reach out to Commissar Stahl. Warm the eastern relationship.
Reach out to both simultaneously. Veltria chooses neither side and will demonstrate why that is a position, not an absence.
